text:
Sam R.: kicking off deploy window for release v2.14.0 to east / eu regions. preflight checks running — watching p95 and 5xx across embed-service and route-proxy. will post updates.
Maria G.: ack. I can watch dashboards, ping me if p95 jumps.
monitoring-bot: automated preflight: running SLO smoke checks for v2.14.0 -> p95, p99, error-rate, rps sampling enabled. baseline window=15m.
Maria G.: eyeballing grafana now — embed-service eu-west p95 jumped from ~70ms to ~220ms at ~10:12 UTC. small 5xx bump (0.08% -> 0.6%).
Alex P.: any correlated deploys in eu-west infra? kubernetes events?
Sam R.: no infra deploys. This is first rollout shard. rolling percentage at 12%.
deploy-bot: rollout progress: v2.14.0 -> 12% traffic, next step in 2m. pause window enabled.
Maria G.: stack traces show increased queue latency on vector-index cache backend. attaching query sample:
```
ERROR embed-service: request_id=8b7a timeout waiting for index-lock (holder=worker-23)
latency_ms=210.3
```
Sam R.: hmm, that smells like a backend contention regression in the new model handler. Can we pin traffic back to v2.13.9 for affected routes?
Alex P.: suggest pause rollout and do a controlled pin for the embeddings route only. if we rollback entirely we'll blow release cadence.
Sam R.: agreed. executing partial hold and pin for route `embeddings.*`
ops-bot: command accepted: `/deploy hold --release v2.14.0 --scope embeddings.*` -> rollout paused at 12%.
deploy-bot: traffic pin applied: embeddings.* -> pinned to v2.13.9 for 10m (manual)
monitoring-bot: snapshot: post-pin metrics (1m sample): embed-service eu-west p95 -> 78ms, 5xx -> 0.09%. good stabilization.
Maria G.: looks stable. can we annotate this in the release notes and follow up with a perf regression triage? I can open a ticket.
Sam R.: please do. include the sample logs, the index-lock stack, and model-handler changelist. I'll hold the rollout and schedule a small canary for the fix later today.
Alex P.: filing ENG-4532 with tags `regression`, `embeddings`, `index-lock`. assign to @maria and @sam.
Sam R.: thanks. leaving pin for 30m to give us a clean window for post-release metrics. if no regressions, we'll resume incremental rollout with a reduced concurrency flag. :thumbsup:
Maria G.: noted. adding a brief blurb to the change-window notes: "v2.14.0 partial hold: embeddings pinned to v2.13.9 due to index-lock regression; follow-up triage ENG-4532."
monitoring-bot: alert cleared: embed-service eu-west 5xx anomaly -> resolved after pin.
Sam R.: closing thread for now. will reopen if any new alerts pop. thanks all. :heart:
